name: Password Breaker
blurb: Works out an account's password one character at a time.

name: Password Breaker
blurb: Twice as fast as version 1, and can take on stronger passwords.

name: Proxy Bypass
blurb: Slips past a proxy so you can change records and logs.

name: Proxy Bypass
blurb: Twice as fast as version 1, and can take on stronger proxies.

name: Firewall Bypass
blurb: Opens a path through a firewall so you can copy and delete files.

name: Firewall Bypass
blurb: Twice as fast as version 1, and can take on stronger firewalls.

name: File Copier
blurb: Copies a file to your gateway.

name: File Deleter
blurb: Deletes a file from a server.

name: Log Deleter
blurb: Removes one line from an access log.

name: Trace Tracker
blurb: Shows how far a trace has got and how long you have left.

name: Monitor Bypass
blurb: Blinds a server's monitor for a short while. Nothing you do is noticed, and a running trace stands still. When it comes back it sees you if you are still inside. Works once per connection.

name: Monitor Bypass
blurb: Twice as fast as version 1, keeps a monitor blind for twice as long, and can take on stronger monitors.

name: Decrypter
blurb: Opens an encrypted file you have copied to your gateway. Runs at home, so nobody is watching while it works.

name: Decompiler
blurb: Takes a program you have copied home apart into modules for your Workbench. Runs at home.

name: Route Planner
blurb: Fills your route in one press on the Route map. This version places four relays and only knows how slow each one is.

name: Route Planner
blurb: Places six relays and reads the map: it sends the route back and forth across borders and oceans.

name: Route Planner
blurb: Places eight relays, reads the map, and knows which relays your target sees through and which are still warm from use.

name: Scanner
blurb: Reads a server's security from the outside, so you know what you are walking into before you connect.

name: Trace Jammer
blurb: Floods a trace with noise and freezes it where it stands for a few seconds. One shot per connection.

name: Password Breaker
blurb: Four times as fast as version 1. Takes on passwords up to the strongest in the field.

name: Password Breaker
blurb: Eight times as fast as version 1. Nothing a company sets as a password will hold it for long.

name: Proxy Bypass
blurb: Four times as fast as version 1. Walks through the hardest proxies.

name: Proxy Bypass
blurb: Eight times as fast as version 1. A proxy barely slows it down.

name: Firewall Bypass
blurb: Four times as fast as version 1. Opens the strongest firewalls.

name: Firewall Bypass
blurb: Eight times as fast as version 1. The port line-up is over almost before it starts.

name: Monitor Bypass
blurb: Four times as fast as version 1. Blinds the quickest monitors.

name: File Copier
blurb: Copies files twice as fast as version 1.

name: File Copier
blurb: Copies files three times as fast as version 1.

name: File Deleter
blurb: Deletes files twice as fast as version 1.

name: File Deleter
blurb: Deletes files three times as fast as version 1.

name: Log Deleter
blurb: Scrubs log lines twice as fast as version 1.

name: Log Deleter
blurb: Scrubs log lines three times as fast as version 1.

name: Decrypter
blurb: Opens an encrypted file twice as fast as version 1.

name: Decrypter
blurb: Opens an encrypted file three times as fast as version 1.

name: Decompiler
blurb: Takes a program apart twice as fast as version 1.

name: Scanner
blurb: Reads a server’s security twice as fast as version 1.

name: Trace Jammer
blurb: Freezes a trace for twice as long as version 1, once per connection.

name: Brute Breaker
blurb: Version 2 strength, built to be fast. Much quicker than the standard version, and it takes more than twice the room.

name: Slim Breaker
blurb: Version 2 strength in a tiny package. Slower than the standard version, and it fits on a nearly full drive.

name: Sprint Firewall
blurb: Version 2 strength, tuned for speed. Fast, and takes a lot of room.

name: Pocket Firewall
blurb: Version 2 strength, trimmed to almost nothing. It takes its time.

name: Whisper Proxy
blurb: Version 2 strength with a light touch. Slower than the standard version, but small.

name: Archivist
blurb: A copier built for large files. A little slower on small ones, much faster on big ones.

name: Wipe Deleter
blurb: A deleter built for large files. A little slower on small ones, much faster on big ones.
